items.headline: Louisville's win vs. UNC ends in brawl as Belichick helps restore order on field
items.description: Louisville's 16-14 win at North Carolina ended with punches thrown and players spilling onto the field, prompting Bill Belichick to help pull players from the melee.

items.headline: Mack's late INT helps Louisville hold off UNC 16-14 in game that ends with brawl
items.description: — Jabari Mack picked off a fourth-down pass from Travis Burgess with 58 seconds left to help Louisville hold off North Carolina 16-14 on Saturday night in a game that ended in a brawl and each of the teams having to be separated.
